articleTitle: Comparison of Machine Learning Techniques for the Detection of the Electricity Theft
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: There are many applications available for detecting the electricity theft. However, only few studies compare the machine learning techniques in discovering electricity-stealing behavior. This study, therefore, compares the predictive accuracy of several machine learning methods including Logistic Regression (LR), The K-Nearest Neighbor Algorithm, (K-NN), Support Vector Machines (SVM), and Neural Networks (NNet) for predicting the electricity thefts in a concrete model.

articleTitle: Research on the Image Segmentation Based on Improved Threshold Extractions
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Image segmentation is one of the classic methods of image signal processing. It is widely used in the industrial inspection, public security, judicial, and so on. Image segmentation using area has a special meaning to distinguish the different areas, and each area has consistency to ensure that each area is the intersection of each other. Based on the threshold and region extraction as the foothold, this paper introduces three typical image segmentation method based on threshold (iterative method global threshold segmentation, Otsu method global threshold segmentation, local threshold segmentation), and comparison of results by using computer simulation show the different of these three methods.

articleTitle: Speed Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Drives Based on Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: A control technique model for predicting the speed of permanent magnet synchronous motor is proposed in this paper in order to cut costs and fortify the stability and effectivity of motor drive, and some simple models of PMSM are employed in the MPC structure. In view of the cross-coupling electromotive force between the direct axis and the quadratic axis in the voltage equation, the dynamic model of PMSM, it is proposed to add a feedforward decoupler to achieve decoupling. The performance of the comparison between MPC with feedforward decoupling and without feedforward decoupling has been carried out, and the feasibility of the proposed scheme is verified by scientific and rigorous simulation experiments. The results proved that the PMSM with the speed and current MPC controller with feedforward decoupling has superior transient response. In addition, more accurate tracking performance has come true.

articleTitle: A High-Order Temperature Compensated CMOS Bandgap Reference
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: In this paper, we present a high-precision bandgap reference(BGR) with high-order temperature compensation. The output voltage of the traditional first-order temperature compensated BGR fluctuates relatively large with change of temperature, leading to the inaccurate supply voltage. In order to improve the accuracy of output voltage, a high-precision BGR circuit is designed based on the CSMC 0.5m BCD process. The circuit uses Brokaw schematic which has small resistance. This schematic is simple and has low static power consumption. In the end of this paper, the circuit is simulated and verified by HSPICE. When the output voltage of the BGR is 2.5V, 3.3V, 5V and 10V, the temperature coefficient(TC) is 1.97ppm/°C, 2.07ppm/°C, 1.76ppm/°C and 4.04ppm/°C within the temperature range (50°C to 120°C), respectively.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fault Diagnosis of Bearing Based on Stacked Denoising Autoencoders
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: A fault diagnosis method based on stacked denosing autoencoder network is proposed to apply deep learning to equipment fault diagnosis. A deep-layer network model is established, pre-training is performed in a layer-by-layer greedy coding mode to achieve adaptive extraction and mining of high-dimensional deep fault features, and then a back-propagation algorithm is used to supervise fine-tune the model. The method integrates the two steps of feature extraction and state classification, and gets rid of the dependence of traditional machine learning methods on artificially extracted sample features, and effectively overcomes the problems of gradient disappearance and local extremum. Through the rolling bearing data experiment, the method's ability to identify and generalize faults was verified.

articleTitle: Sprouting Potato Recognition Based on Deep Neural Network GoogLeNet
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: In this paper, the convolution neural network GoogLeNet is applied to sprouting potato recognition. In order to meet the needs of Screening for sprouting potatoes, image recognition technology is required. The traditional identification technology must describe the features of the objects specifically, but it is difficult to describe the features of complex potato shoots. Therefore, the deep neural network is used to identify the sprouting potatoes. In addition, the overall network model is applied on embedded devices for reducing the hardware expense. And the model on the embedded devices should have less training parameters and stronger expression capabilities than the model on PC. Therefore, the GooLeNet model is used to classify pictures. The research results show that the recognition rate of sprouting potatoes reached 80%, and the GooLeNet model has a great potential for sprouting potato recognition.

articleTitle: A Method of Quick Edge Detection Based on Zynq
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Most of existing image processing algorithms have poor real-time performance in embedded device applications and occupy too much software resources. In this paper, a fast edge detection method is proposed based on Zynq platform. The xfOpenCv acceleration library provided by Xilinx is used to implement the edge detection algorithm. Specifically, the function operation process is accelerated in the FPGA through the acceleration constraint of a specific function implemented in the xfOpenCv library. In the implementation process, the SDx development environment is also used to simplify the function hardware acceleration development process. The experimental results show that our edge detection method takes less time than other methods, and has better real-time performance with the basically same detection results.

articleTitle: Aircraft Detection in Remote Sensing Images Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Aircraft detection in remote sensing images is always the research hotspot but a challenging task for the variations of aircraft type, pose, size and complex background. The paper proposes a region-based convolutional neural network to detect aircrafts. To enhance the learning ability of the network, a multi-resolution aircraft remote sensing dataset is collected from Google Earth. Then, the detection model is trained end to end by fine-tuning on the obtained dataset and realizes automatic aircraft recognition and positioning. Experiments show that the proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art method on the same dataset and the requirement for real-time can be satisfied simultaneously.

articleTitle: Modeling and Studying of the 16-QAM Based System over the Fading Channel
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Because of the complex electromagnetic propagation phenomena and the requirement of more and more bandwidth, the importance of studying the wireless channel becomes more and more crucial. In order to study the performance of 16-QAM based wireless system, it first gives an overview of fading channels and then studies the 16-QAM modulation, at last, the performance of transmission mode are evaluated by BER and SER over the AWGN channel and the Rayleigh + Rician + AWGN channel, separately. The simulation results show that the performance of 16-QAM based system is better than the 4-FSK based system, and compared with signal travels over the Rayleigh + Rician + AWGN channel, the SNR is higher over the AWGN channel.

articleTitle: Application of VMD in Fault Diagnosis for Rolling Bearing under Variable Speed Conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Two strategies, namely, computed order tracking variational mode decomposition (COT-VMD) and VMD filtering envelope order, are proposed and applied respectively to the fault diagnosis of rolling bearings under variable speed conditions. In the COT-VMD strategy, time domain signal was transformed into angle domain by the computed order tracking technology, and then the stationary signal in the angle domain was conducted with VMD, based on which the order spectrum of each mode were obtained. In the VMD filtering- envelope order strategy, however, a time domain envelope of filtered signal by VMD was resampled, after that the envelope order spectrum can be gotten through FFT. The results of fault diagnosis for rolling bearings under variable speed conditions show that both of the two proposed strategies can achieve typical fault diagnosis for rolling bearing, expanding the application of VMD in fault diagnosis under variable speed conditions.

articleTitle: Cyclic Cumulant Based On Communication Signal Multilayer Neural Network Modulation Pattern Recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: After deducing and simulating the cyclic spectrum theory of MPSK and MQAM modulated signals, the cyclic spectrum of the modulated signal is preprocessed and the original feature set is formed as the input data of the CNN. With feature extraction of cyclic spectrum from convolution and subsampling layers of CNN, the modulation signal can be effectively identified within and between classes. The experimental simulation results show that the classification and recognition algorithm of communication signal modulation mode proposed in this paper has better modulation recognition accuracy than other traditional modulation recognition algorithms in the case of low SNR. And when the signal to noise ratio is lower than 5db and higher than -5db, the modulation pattern recognition accuracy can be reached up to 92%.

articleTitle: Design of Logistic Regression Health Assessment Model Using Novel Quantum PSO
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Logistic regression health assessment is an important direction to make full use of modern information technology knowledge. A novel quantum particle swarm optimization is used in this paper to study and develop related technical level and realize early identification and intervention of disease risk factors. The comparative experimental results verify the effectiveness and the proposed method is an effective method to design Logistic regression health assessment model.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Real-time Monitoring System for Wireless Coverage Data Based on WebSocket
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: At the beginning of the wireless signal planning and after the completion of the construction, the integrity and stability of the wireless signal need to be continuously monitored. At present, most existing wireless signal monitoring systems adopt the C/S structure, which has the disadvantages of high cost of development, maintenance and update, real-time and poor compatibility. WebSocket-based wireless coverage data real-time monitoring system adopts WebSocket protocol and B/S structure to realize asynchronous full-duplex communication between client and server. It has the advantages of strong real-time communication, low network bandwidth resource consumption and strong compatibility.

articleTitle: Cloud-based Adaptive Quantum Genetic Algorithm for Solving Flexible Job Shop Scheduling Problem
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: The quantum genetic algorithm is improved for the flexible shop scheduling problem. In this paper, a quantum genetic algorithm adaptively adjusting the rotation angle is designed to solve the flexible shop scheduling problem. The randomness and stability tendency of the cloud model are used to adaptively adjust the rotation angle to improve the optimization ability of the algorithm. At the same time, quantum crossover and quantum variability are used to improve population diversity and prevent premature convergence. Numerical experiments show that the algorithm has good performance.

articleTitle: Tiny Electronic Component Detection Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Tiny electronic component detection mostly suffers from compact size and multiple interferences of environment. To solve this problem, this paper presents an object detection method based on convolutional neural networks (CNNs). This method combines residual blocks in residual networks with CNNs. The CNNs can reduce the dimensions of the image, and the residual block in the residual network can train deeper neural networks, and then use the successful application of CNNs in computer vision to improve the recognition rate of components and improve the efficiency of automated processing of tiny electronic components. After the hyper-parameter adjustment, this method achieved 95.63% accuracy on our test set.

articleTitle: Design of Far Field Beamforming Problem by Window Function
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: The design of the broadband beamformer problem is to find the coefficients vector for all FIR filters such that output fits to a given target spatial directivity pattern in a specified domain. This problem is always very complicated. In this paper, a fast window function method is proposed to solve this problem. First, a simplified optimization problem is formulated, where the frequency response function is the decision function. Then an optimal frequency response vector can be obtained by solving this problem. Next the window function is applied to cut off the infinite length of the coefficient. The window function method is efficient and can be applied in real time applications. Numerical example is illustrated to show the efficiency of the method.

articleTitle: Improved Single Target Tracking Learning Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: In order to improve the robustness and the speed of single target tracking, this paper proposes an improved Tracking Learning Detection method. By modifying the tracking module in the traditional TLD algorithm, introducing the ORB feature points with fast matching speed and retaining the original uniform distribution points, the execution speed and robustness of the algorithm can be improved. The experiment shows that the improved TLD algorithm has strong robustness in different experimental environments and can quickly and accurately track the single object. The algorithm proposed in this paper effectively overcomes the tracking failures caused by the moving target`s partial occlusion, rapid movement and departure from the tracking field of vision. It has better robustness, accuracy and faster execution speed than traditional TLD algorithm.

articleTitle: A New Multi-Agent Model of Workshop Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the characteristics and requirements of the virtual workshop and the multi-agent system, this paper proposes the scheduling unit model of the multi-agent virtual workshop. According to this model, an improved genetic algorithm with simple modeling and fast computing speed is designed for scheduling, which can be used for scheduling problems of multiple projects in multiple virtual workshops with the same task type.

articleTitle: Segmental Deployment of Neural Network in Cloud Robotic System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: In this paper, we describe a new method for ep neural networks in the field of computer vision, which can effectively solve the difficulty of applying deep learning in the cloud robotic system. By segmenting the trained network, most of the computing tasks can be cut out and offloaded to the cloud. By effective feature extraction and compression methods, the computing power of robot and cloud can be integrated and coordinated. A method of selecting the split points of the network model and a method of data transmission and compression in the communication between robots and cloud after segmenting are given based on the characteristics of machine vision tasks, and the theoretical analysis is carried out. In the experiment, the effectiveness of all the above methods is verified by comparing the compression capability, response time and network performance of the actual network model. The experimental results show that with the use of segmental methods in cloud robotic system, the task of deep network is processed in real time, while the performance is almost guaranteed.

articleTitle: Analysis on Kinematics and Workspace of the Palletizing Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: After determining the structural parameters of the palletizing robot, it is necessary to check whether these structural parameters meet the basic work requirements. In order to achieve this goal, it is necessary to compare actual robot's workspace with task space required by work. Only when robot's workspace contains its task space can robot complete its task. In this paper, D-H method is used to set up the homogeneous transformation matrix between end effector coordinate system and base coordinate system of palletizing robot to build its kinematic models, and MATLAB software is used to analyze and calculate the palletizing robot's workspace in detail. Finally, this paper compares the two point, and the results suggest that robot's workspace can contain its task space. This study would be useful for the kinematical characteristics of palletizing robot in space and provide a basis for robot's structural optimization from kinematic view.

articleTitle: Estimation of Impulse Noise Parameters in Power Line Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: In this paper, an algorithm that estimates the parameters of impulse noise (IN) is proposed in power line communication. The Peak to Average Power Ratio (PAPR) of the Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) symbol sent by the transmitter is reduced by the selective mapping (SLM) technology. In addition, the peak value of each OFDM symbol is sent with a separate control channel. At receiver, the frequency characteristics of IN is calculated using the received peak value and the OFDM symbol. The noise used for simulation comes from actual measurement. Results from simulations show that the proposed algorithm can estimate the IN well under different IN environments, and the obtained parameters are very valuable for mitigating IN in power line communication.

articleTitle: Maximum Power Point Tracking Algorithm for Laser Power Beaming Based on Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: With the high voltage intelligent substation developing at a pretty high speed, more and more artificial intelligent techniques have been incorporated into the power devices to meet the automation needs. For the sake of the line maintenance staff's safety, the high voltage isolating switch draws great attention among the most important power devices because of its capability of connecting and disconnecting the high voltage circuit. However, due to high-voltage isolating switch's working environment, the power supply system of the surveillance devices could suffer from great electromagnetic interference. Laser power beaming exhibits its merits in such situation because it can provide steady power from a distance despite the day or the night. Then the energy conversion efficiency arises as a new concern. To make full use of the laser power, this paper mainly focuses on extracting the maximum power from the photovoltaic (PV) panel. And a neural network based algorithm is proposed which combines both the intrinsic and the extrinsic features of the PV panel with the proportion of the voltage of the maximum power point (MPP) to the open circuit voltage of the PV panel. Simulations and experiments are carried out to verify the validness and feasibility of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Mathematical Model of Inverse Heat Conduction Problem in Laminar Cooling Process
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: The cooling process after rolling has a decisive effect on the performance of hot rolled steel plate. The key to improve the cooling technology after rolling is to know the effect of process parameters during the laminar cooling process. Heat transfer coefficient is an important physical parameter in cooling process, but it is difficult to solve it directly. Nowadays, the heat transfer coefficient is mainly calculated by empirical formulas. This method cannot meet the requirements of different plant conditions. In this paper, the conjugate gradient method, the genetic algorithm and the noniterative method are used to establish the mathematical model to solve the inverse heat conduction problem in the laminar cooling process of the heavy plate, and the heat transfer coefficient is calculated and analyzed. The research results show that the conjugate gradient method and the genetic algorithm inverse calculation model are suitable for solving the inverse nonlinear heat conduction problem. The accuracy of the temperature measurement close to the boundary is higher than that of the internal temperature measurement point.

articleTitle: A Quick Method of System Function and Theoretical Model Test of a Three-order Narrow Band Digital Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: On the basis of simulative filters design, a three-order experimental digital filter is realized which has a centre frequency of 50Hz, the largest attenuation of 3dB in 4dB-width band-pass, the lest attenuation of 20dB in the stop-band which is less than 45Hz and more than 55Hz. Simulation results of the design are presented. The synthetic results suggest that the design method is effective and can satisfy the demand for high sampling rate.

articleTitle: Diagnostic Strategy Optimization Method under Unreliable Test
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low diagnosis accuracy and high false alarm rate in the fault diagnosis of complex systems, the research of diagnosis strategy optimization method based on information entropy algorithm under unreliable test conditions is studied. A heuristic function that comprehensively considers the fault detection capability, information volume, test cost, and test result trustworthiness of the test point is established. The information entropy algorithm is used to generate the diagnostic strategy. Finally, the Apollo detection system example is used to verify the superiority of the algorithm. Theoretical and experimental results show that the average test cost of the information entropy algorithm is lower than that of the $AO^{\ast}$ algorithm, and the calculation time is within an acceptable range. Therefore, it can be used to test the design of diagnostic strategies under unreliable conditions.

articleTitle: An Active Set Approximation Method for the Design of Broadband Beamformer
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: The microphone array beamformer design problem in far-field environment is to design the coefficients of FIR filters such that the maximum error between the actual response and the desired response in a specified domain is minimized. The specified domain is always very large and this problem is a large scale optimization problem. In general the complexity of the optimal method for solving this problem is very expensive. This paper applies an active set approximation method to solve this problem. First, this paper transforms this problem into a semi-infinite programming problem. Next, this paper finds an approximate active set such that the scale of the problem can be mostly reduced. Then, this problem can be solved efficiently and the approximate solution is very close to the optimal solution. Numerical experiments are illustrated to show the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency optimization in OFDM Power Telecommunication Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: The energy efficiency performance of Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) in cellular networks is strongly affected by power allocations and channel allocations due to the inter-cell interference. This paper presents the energy efficiency optimization problem in OFDM-based cellular networks. To the end, an energy efficiency optimization function is constructed, which maximizes energy efficiency and guarantees users' requirement. Since the model proposed is a nonlinear fractional program, which is NP-hard. To solve the model, the paper uses the successive convex appropriate method to appropriate the objective function. And then it uses the Lagrange dual method and sub-gradient to address the sub-optimal problem. Simulation results show that energy efficiency is convergence and maximum energy efficiency performance can be obtained.

articleTitle: Abnormal Detection Based on Covariance Sparse Approximation Gaussian Process
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: The forecasting methods based on Gaussian Process Regression are widely used in abnormal detection of time series data. These methods have strong generalization, and their outputs have a probabilistic significance, suitable for dealing with nonlinear and complex regression problems. However, the application of full Gaussian Process is intractable for large data set because of the time complexity. To this end, Covariance Sparse Approximation Gaussian Process (CSAGP) is employed to build the prediction model. The key idea is to use inducing points for computing cross-covariance between training, testing and inducing points to reduce the complexity significantly. This method is applied to regression and abnormal detection. Further, it is compared with other Gaussian Process approaches in the paper. The experimental results show that this method can greatly reduce the time complexity while ensuring the accuracy of model prediction.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Recognition of Train Image Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Machine Vision has become a new technique in the AI field of image processing as an important and useful technique. Thus, it is significant to study image fusion on train fault. Image fusion mainly studies the image data fusion technology to obtain a synthetic image including the multiple images of the same scene from many different patterns by the image sensors or the same sensor at the different time. In this paper, the images are collected form the bogie and coupler draft devices in the operation of train, and these images are merged based on wavelet transform. Compared with the weighted average fusion method about the fusion results of subjective and objective evaluation the superiority of wavelet transform is fully proved.

articleTitle: Health Status Evaluation of Switching Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: The normal operation of the system is affected by the health condition of the electronic equipment used in switching voltage stabilizing power supply. In this paper, a high-precision simulation model is established and different degradation is set up. Based on EDA technology, the overall health status evaluation method of switching power supply is studied. This paper constructs a standard database of power degradation characteristics and adopts the least squares fitting method to determine the relationship between the stress factors and the output of the system. Furthermore, the actual state of the power supply under arbitrary stress combination can be evaluated. The reliability of this method is verified by the assessment of the actual state of the power of a certain anti-shock switch.

articleTitle: Research on Jitter Buffering Algorithm Based on E-MODEL Optimized Speech Quality
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: With the popularization and development of the Internet, Voice over IP (VoIP) technology is more and more widely used in the communication. However, due to the Internet network protocol of "best effort" service, it cannot provide excellent quality of service for voice transmission. The network end-to-end delay, jitter and packet loss will seriously affect the voice quality at the receiver. In order to reduce the damage of speech quality caused by delay jitter, this paper proposes a new jitter buffer algorithm based on the Atzori's algorithm, in which the E-model is used to evaluate speech quality at the user level. Then it combines the statistical distribution to the delay modeling, and improves the speech collection of Atzori's algorithm to avoid the statistical error which regards the optimal delay of the last talkspurt as the buffer delay of the current talkspurt. Finally, it finds the balance between delay and packet loss, and searches for the optimal speech quality to set the buffer size. Experiments show that the proposed algorithm would significantly improve the speech quality compared with Atzori's algorithm in wired unidirectional network and wireless bi-directional network.

articleTitle: Multiple Invariance PM-based Blind Carrier Frequency Offset Estimation for Multiple Antennas OFDM Electrical Special Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: The electrical wireless network builds 4G TD-LTE network in 1.8GHz band. Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) and multiple antennas are the key technologies. This paper considers the problem of carrier frequency offset (CFO) estimation for multiple antenna OFDM system, which is the key technique in 4D TD-LTE network. In the proposed algorithm, the received signal is reconstructed so that the multi-invariance property could be exploited for CFO estimation. The proposed algorithm performs better than the propagator method (PM) and estimating signal parameters via rotational invariance techniques (ESPRIT). Furthermore, the proposed algorithm has low complexity since it has no requirement for eigenvalue decomposition (EVD) of the cross correlation matrix nor singular value decomposition (SVD) of the received data. Simulation results illustrate effectiveness and improvement of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Compact Antenna Array for LTE1.8GHz Electric Power Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: The LTE technology, which adopts OFDM and MIMO, can meet the needs of electric power wireless communication for automatic distribution business. This paper designs a two-element MIMO antenna array which may be applied to the LTE1.8GHz electric power wireless communication systems. The antenna array has high port isolation by using the defect ground structure (DGS) while maintaining a compact structure. The simulation results show that the antenna array has a port isolation of about 15 dB and small size, which is suitable for usage in the terminal devices of the power distribution network.

articleTitle: Application of Hybrid Quantum Behaved Particle Swarm Optimization in Multi-objective Flexible Job Shop Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: In the flexible job shop scheduling (FJSP) environment, the complexity of solving multiple objectives is still a hot topic. When the hybrid quantum particle swarm optimization(QPSO)algorithm is used to solve the flexible job shop, a rule initialization is used to ensure the quality of the initial solution when initializing the particle, so that it begins to search in the better direction. Aiming at the weakness of quantum particle group which is easy to fall into local optimum, this paper proposes to use the fast non-dominated sorting in NSGAII to find the non-dominated solution in the external repository, calculate the congestion degree using the crowded distance, and select the congestion degree according to the bidding selection method. The largest particle is used as the global optimal position, and its purpose is to guide each particle to search for the non-dominated solution of the sparse region, which is closer to the pareto solution. Experiments show that the hybrid quantum particle population has better convergence and the ability to maintain population diversity than other algorithms.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Type of Electromagnetic Active Vibration Absorber
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: A new type of electromagnetic active vibration absorber is designed and analyzed to study the factors and laws affecting the magnitude of its output force. By analyzing the magnetic circuit structure and using the equivalent magnetic circuit method, the output force of the electromagnetic absorber is obtained. The formula is used to qualitatively analyze the output force of the actuator by adjusting the characteristics of the input current. The simulation results of the active vibration absorber are compared with the experimental ones to validate the design theory and the performance of the proposed active vibration absorber.

articleTitle: Impulse Signal Transmission and Synthesis Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Transmission and synthesis characteristics of impulse signals is one of key technologies of the time-domain radar system. This paper regards the unit antenna as the radiation power and gives transmission and synthesis characteristics of the array antenna impulse signals. From theoretical and experimental results, the experimental results are consistent with theoretical analysis well, which provides important theoretical basis for us to further study impulse signals and develop a complete impulse radar.

articleTitle: Study on LED Color Mixing for Stage Lighting Based on Locus Fitting of Blackbody
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Aiming at overcoming the defects of basic lighting color rendering for LED stage lighting, this paper establishes a new mixing light method with RGBW four-color mixing model. Compared with traditional tricolor light mixing model, it uses the mixing light of white as the fourth input, with the three-basic color of red, green and blue to obtain a new mixing method. Then the original coefficients of RGBW are optimized after adjusting the two parameters of relative spectral power distribution and illuminance of mixing light for locus fitting of blackbody. Finally, better color rendering of white light can be acquired. By the MATLAB simulation and field testing, experimental results have shown that the proposed method will achieve ideal LED lighting performance, which is convenient for color management of lighting control system in modern theatre.

articleTitle: An Improved Centroid Localization Algorithm Based on Virtual Beacon Nodes for WSNs
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: According to the application of range-free localization technology for wireless sensor networks (WSNs), an improved centroid localization algorithm is proposed in the paper. In this methodology, the centroid of the space enclosed by connected beacon nodes is considered as a virtual beacon node. It can be proved that the coordinate of the centroid and the received signal strength indication (RSSI) between the unknown node and the centroid could be calculated. When the beacon node with the weakest RSSI is replaced by this virtual beacon node, the space enclosed by connected beacon nodes is reduced and the location precision can be improved. Monte Carlo tests validate that the proposed algorithm has strong robustness and can achieve a good performance of localization precision and coverage.

articleTitle: Disruption Management in Vehicle Routing Problem Based on Prospect Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: In order to revolve the problem of disruption management in the process of terminal logistics, the author proposes a new method on the basis of the prospect theory. Firstly, a multi-objective mathematical model of disruption management is established. Secondly, in the view of the customer, the degree of the customer's psychological perception is measured with the prospect theory to get perception curve. At last, the effectiveness of the proposed quantum bacterial foraging algorithm is verified through comparing with the existing classical algorithms.

articleTitle: Track to Track Association Based on Iterative Reference Pattern
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Track to track association (TTTA) is a key problem in the multi-sensor data fusion system. Traditional TTTA algorithms are based on the absolute position information of targets degrade in the presence of sensor biases, which make the position estimates of targets deviate from their true values. Reference pattern (REP), which uses global structural feature of the spatial distribution of targets, is insensitive to sensor biases. However, false tracks can bring extraneous interferences to REP, while missed detections can result in partial loss of the structural feature. This paper, thus, presents a new TTTA approach based on iterative reference pattern (IREP). On one hand, the proposed method inherits the insensitivity of REP to sensor biases. On the other hand, it alleviates the adverse impact of false tracks and missed detections on REP by introducing the iterative process, which refines the reference track set (RDS) dynamically. Simulation results verify the performance superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Simulation of Traffic Impact of Self-driving Vehicle Based on Cellular Automata
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: One of the main causes of traffic jam is due to volume of traffic exceeding the designed capacity of the road networks. This paper has established a model to research the feasibility of alleviating congestion by introducing self-driving vehicles. And this paper has determined specific influences on the traffic networks after introducing these vehicles.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Integrated Monitoring of Subway Electrical Equipment
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Subway electrical equipment integrated monitoring design, based on the subway operation environment, is a method to perform safe operation. The designs in this paper are closely related to the subway electrical equipment integrated monitoring system, that is, station ventilation and air conditioning monitoring system. This paper introduces the monitoring system of subway electromechanical equipment making programmable controller as the main controller. The control system is technically advanced. The use of communication interface instead of the traditional electrical interface and the redundant dual-ring network has greatly improved the reliability of the system with great economic and social benefits.

articleTitle: Blind Image Quality Assessment Model Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: As learning-based models become predominant in image processing field, especially in image classification and object detection, image quality assessment (IQA) has been a hot issue since the quality of train images is of great importance fro model performance. This paper proposes a novel blind IQA model evolved from VGG-16 [1], a state-of-the-art classification deep convolutional neural network(CNN). It modifies the classification network to apply it to regression task by keeping only one neuron in the last fully-connected layer, the output of which is considered as the quality assessment metric after being normalized to a score between 0 and 1 via Sigmoid function. And experimental results demonstrate that this model achieves a superb assessment performance on TID-2013 dataset [2].

articleTitle: An Effective Hungarian Algorithm-Based Pairing Strategy for RAMA
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: In this paper, a close upper bound of the sum rate of a relay-aided multiple access (RAMA) model is deduced and a method is proposed to solve the user pairing problem of RAMA. In our concerned model, some users (UEs) is exploited as relays in order to improve the transmit rate of other UEs that are in bad channel condition. The ideal sum rate of the model is deduced according to Shannon's theorem. Based on the expression of sum rate, the method is studied to match RAMA pairs and proposed an algorithm which is based on Hungarian algorithm. It provides high transmit rate and is of relatively low cost. In our research the rate of both the whole cell and the best matched pair is considered. The simulation results of our proposed method confirmed that the solution based on Hungarian algorithm can achieve nearly optimum performance.

articleTitle: A Weighted Bayesian Probability Model of Mental Disorders and Sleep Quality in Different Age Groups
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: It is studied that the sleep time of most people is more than a third of their lives in their lifetime, thus people's health is closely linked to their sleep quality. Nowadays, the rate of insomnia in Chinese adults is as high as 38.2%, and the rate of insomnia in adolescents is rising gradually. With the rapid increasing number of insomnia, the number of mental disease caused by poor sleep quality also shows an increasing tendency. In this paper, Pittsburgh sleep quality index (PSQI) is taken as the criteria of sleep quality. Considering the different correlation between PSQI and diagnosis results in different age groups, the probability of relationship between the sleep quality and diagnosis results in different age groups are calculated. Based on the contrast intensity and conflict between the indexes, the CRITIC method is used to calculate the weight of each index, and establish the Bayesian weighted probability model. After building the model, the random experiment is used to test the accuracy of the model. Comparing the probability of the test value with the real value, the result indicates that the fitting effect is good..

articleTitle: User Privacy Protection Method Based on Dynamic Hiding
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: The most commonly used method of location privacy protection is location K-anonymization. At present, most of the K-anonymization models are aimed at the attackers who do not understand the users' background knowledge. The probability of hacking will increase when they know about users. This paper proposes a multi-level meshing method to predict the user's trajectory according to the user's historical track data recorded by the LBS (location based service) server. Then the LBS server determines whether to dynamically adjust the location of the corresponding user in the K-anonymization model K-degree anonymous and remove the redundancy of the anonymous area while satisfying the K-degree anonymous. Due to the increase of the anonymous area, the impact on the quality of the LBS server is reduced. The experiments verify that this method is effective to the privacy protection of users when attackers know about the background knowledge.

articleTitle: Sonar Detection Performance Model and Simulation in Deep Sea Convergence Zone
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Oceanic acoustic convergence is a typical acoustic propagation phenomenon in the marine environment. Under this condition, sonar can usually achieve long-range target detection. This paper mainly focuses on how to accurately assess the sonar detection ability under the phenomenon of acoustic convergence. Combining the acoustic propagation model with the sonar target detection theory, a quantitative performance evaluation model is constructed which evaluates the sonar detection ability. Factors affecting the sonar detection ability are analyzed. Simulation results show that this model is effective.

articleTitle: A Novel Sensorless Control ASIC for Brushless DC Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: A novel BLDCM commutation control ASIC is designed and implemented. This paper designs a novel commutation control system, which only detects zero crossing points of back EMF from two phases, and obtains the other commutation points by piecewise prediction algorithm, and designs adaptive threshold control algorithm for filtering the commutation interference signal. The novel method not only simplifies the circuit but also increases the stability of the system. The commutation control part has been designed as ASIC based on UMC 0.18um 1P6M Mixed-Mode 1.8V Twin-Well technology. The test results of control system based on ASIC show that the motor runs steadily and the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Predictive PI Cascade Control Strategy for Dual-capacity System with Long Dead-time
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: In industrial process control, quite many dual-capacity system with long dead-time can be encountered. The predictive PI cascade control strategy for dual-capacity system is proposed, which is simple in structure, intuitive in tuning parameters and robust in performance. Then, this paper analyzes the stability of dual-capacity predictive PI cascade control system and the stability condition is obtained. Also, the parameters tuning method based on simulated annealing algorithm is proposed to reduce the difficulty of tuning parameters. Through a practical application, predictive PI cascade control strategy and PID cascade control strategy are compared, and the result shows predictive PI cascade control strategy has the better setpoint tracking capability and stronger rejection performance.

articleTitle: Aggregation Model of Variable Frequency Motors and the Analysis of Active Power and Reactive Power Demand under Transient State
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: In view of the increasing use of variable frequency drive equipment, the active and reactive demand characteristics of a power grid with a high percentage of variable frequency load under transient state are analyzed. Due to the fact that a large number of variable frequency motors in power grid cannot be modeled one by one, an aggregation motor model is needed to approximate them. In this paper, a variable frequency motor model is built on the MATLAB/Simulink simulation platform, and the influence of frequency converter on induction motors aggregation is analyzed. Then, an induction motors aggregation method is used to aggregate the variable frequency motors. The transient simulation of the power grid is carried out when the induction motors and the variable frequency motors respectively occupy a high proportion. The simulation results show that variable frequency motors show different load characteristics from the conventional induction motors, and a large number of them can make the system suffer the active impact after the fault recovery process.

articleTitle: An Improved Collaborative Filtering Combining User Preference and Trust
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: To solve the sparseness problem which affects the performance of the recommendation system, a collaborative filtering algorithm combining user preference and trust degree is proposed. The rating grade, rating authority and rating recognition are used to calculate the trust between users which integrates with Pearson similarity by weighting to obtain the trusted similarity. In addition, the information entropy theory is introduced to obtain the difference information entropy between users according to the user-item rating matrix. At last, the trusted similarity and the difference information entropy are weighted to obtain the overall similarity which used to predict the rating of the target user. The simulation shows that the proposed algorithm has a higher performance than the traditional collaborative filtering algorithm which measures the similarity between users using PCC.

articleTitle: Direction Finding Using Coprime Array with Sensor Gain and Phase Errors
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: This paper investigates the issue of direction finding of multiple signals using coprime array with sensor gain and phase errors. As the sensor errors decrease the performance of direction estimation, it proposes a calibration method with one signal, where one accurate direction signal enables to obtain high precise result. By building the rough direction signal in real system as usual, it introduces the gain self-calibration and iterative self-calibration to enhance the performance of error estimation, which is based on the rough error estimate by one signal calibration. Considering the analysis of computational complexity and performance simulation, the gain self-calibration improves the performance in low signal to noise ratio compared with no self-calibration and the iterative self-calibration gets the best performance with the most computational complexity. With known error values, it can be found more signals than the sensor number with coprime array.

articleTitle: Survivability optimization of the Silo Group Deployment by Agent Modeling and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Survivability is an important indicator for the nuclear weapon deployed by silo group. From the view of survivability optimization, firstly, a brief analysis for A-side factors, B-side factors and environmental factors that affect survivability of the silo group is completed, extract the main factors and make corresponding limitations. Secondly, agent modeling method is introduced to establish the silo agent model, detail the model rules, analyze the changes in the deployment status of the silo group using the Markov process, and construct an objective function model for the optimization of the silo group survivability. Finally, simulation based on the objective function is performed, and the simulation result shows that the problem of survivability optimization deployment of the silo group get some sort of solution, which may provide reference for similar military target deployment problems.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of EMU Health Management Cloud Platform for Multi-source Information
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: In view of the complex characteristics of high-speed EMU composition and operating environment, the evaluation of EMU health status should be based on a comprehensive consideration of various factors. This paper proposes the EMU health management cloud platform for multi-source information. Firstly, it introduced the research status for health management of EMU and the relevant influencing factors. Secondly, based on PHM and cloud platform technology, functional design and overall framework of EMU health management cloud platform were proposed. On this basis, a multi-factor model for evaluating the health of the traction converter cooling system of the EMU was constructed by using deep neural network (DNN), and the accuracy and availability of the model were verified by an example.

articleTitle: An Acquisition Method of Multi-channel Short Code Guiding Long Code in Non-integer DSSS Ranging
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: In order to achieve the relative measurement of the satellite link in the Global Satellite Navigation Constellation, the proposed bidirectional ranging is the key technology to solve the autonomous operation of constellation. In order to improve the ranging precision and shorten the ranging time, an acquisition method of multi-channel short code guiding long code in non-integer DSSS (direct sequence spread spectrum system) is proposed in the non-integer multiple DSSS, which can improve the ranging accuracy to 0. 3m. Considering the resources used, the paper has analyzed and selected different long code of short truncation and different multi-channels, which greatly shortened the time for ranging. The different long code short truncation codes and different parallel ones are selected, which shortens the ranging time to a large extent.

articleTitle: Signal Processing and Fast Verification Method for an Embedded Microprocessor Based PWM High-Fidelity Audio Playback System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: A PWM high-fidelity audio playback system including only a general-purpose embedded microprocessor, switching power transistors and output filter has been designed and measured. The design uses digital signal processing and class D amplifier to amplify audio signals with high efficiency and low distortion. Signal processing uses sample rate conversion, noise shaping and equalization to convert high-fidelity PCM audio input to PWM output. A software approach that can verify the quality of the output before hardware implementation is discussed. Results measured on a prototype board show this approach delivers 200W into a 4 ohm loudspeaker with S3% efficiency, 96 dB SNR and 0.02% THD.

articleTitle: Simulation of Route Planning for Deep Sea Mining Vehicle Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: In this paper, the deep sea mining vehicle is taken as the research object, and the complex terrain environment model of the deep sea is established based on the grid method. On the basis of basic ant colony algorithm, an improved ant colony algorithm is proposed, and the corresponding mathematical model is established, which can offset the drawbacks of the basic ant colony algorithm in the route planning of deep sea mining vehicle. The basic ant colony algorithm and improved ant colony algorithm are used to simulate and compare the driving path of deep-sea mining vehicle. The results show that the improved ant colony algorithm has better search efficiency in the path planning of deep sea mining vehicle, and it is beneficial to obtain the optimal path, being of guiding significance for the autonomous driving of seabed mining vehicle.

articleTitle: Anti-eavesdropping Scheme on Physical Layer for Full-duplex Relay System Based on SWIPT
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: A secure transmission scheme of anti-eavesdropping on the physical layer in simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) is proposed. Each node in the system is a single-antenna node. There are direct links between eavesdropping node and the source or relay node. The relay work in a full-duplex mode, which uses the amplify-and-forward method to forward the signal. The relay collects energy from the received radio frequency (RF) signal and uses it for forwarding. The destination node is also a full-duplex node, sends artificial noise to perform cooperative interference while receiving information to intercept the eavesdropping node. Aiming at maximizing the secrecy rate of the system, the power splitting factor, signal and artificial noise power distribution factor are optimized when the relay adopts the power splitting method. Simulation results suggest that the use of power splitting way and cooperative interference scheme at destination can significantly improve the performance of system.

articleTitle: The Contactless Measurement for Big Cargo Extraction of Trajectory and Attitude Parameters Based on Multi-station and Differ-reference
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: In view of the narrow long room, fast speed and roll sport while outside the room, single camera couldn't achieve the measurement of big cargo extraction. This paper puts forward an intersection measurement system of multiple ultra short focus cameras and high-speed cameras. The system can achieve the parameters of wholly sport process by measuring the marked points on cargo, coordinate conversion and data registration. Measurement data show the trajectory and attitude parameters truly. Measurement precision satisfies the requirement of subject.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analyzing Per-Flow Saturation Throughput for Wireless Ad Hoc Networks with Directional Antennas
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Throughput is an important factor to estimate the performance of wireless ad hoc networks. However, what remains unaddressed is how to analyze the per-flow saturation throughput for networks with directional antennas. In this paper, a three-dimensional Markov chain model is used to analyze the per-flow saturation throughput in the typical directional random access protocol (D-MAC protocol). Simulation results show that different flows have different saturation throughputs due to directional hidden terminals. Therefore, this paper focuses on analyzing per-flow saturation throughput in single-hop directional ad hoc networks. It first derives the transmission probability when taking the three-dimensional Markov chain model into account, then analyzes the collision probability of each flow considering collisions caused by directional hidden terminals. The paper further studies the per-flow saturation throughput in the network. Extensive simulations demonstrate the accuracy of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Integrated Intermediate Frequency Digital Processing of Multi-channel Transponders Based on TCAS and Mode S
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: This paper studies the design method of intermediate frequency digital processing for Traffic Alert and Collision Avoidance System (TCAS) receiver and mode S transponder. The system adopts full Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) design to realize 64MHz high-speed digital signal processing. Since the digital processing of TCAS receiver and mode S transponder in the middle frequency segment and the consistency of baseband processing, the design concept of integrated avionics system and software radio technology are applied in the design of TCAS receiver and mode S transponder, so as to change the traditional joint system architecture and realize the shared platform resources.

articleTitle: The Suppression of Impact Noise in Wind Turbine Gearbox Vibration Signal
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Root mean square (RMS) of acceleration signal is one of the important parameters to monitor the wind turbine gearbox condition. Impulse noise appears with large energy and short time when gearbox suffers sudden change of wind speed and load. RMS error from data calculation influences the accuracy of condition judgment, so it is significant to filter impact noise which is non-periodic and random, which is regarded as small probability event in the whole gearbox operation time. The original vibration signal was processed by statistical method to draw histogram, mean and variance are obtained by the normal distribution. Normal data of signal, occupying an absolute proportion, was in the middle of the histogram. Impulse noise with high amplitude occupies a small proportion both sides of the histogram. At last, impact noise was eliminated from a field wind turbine vibration data by the criterion of μ ± 3σ , illustrating the effect of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Asynchronous control issue for neural networks of neutral type with both Markovian jumping parameters and time-varying delay
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: The asynchronous control problem is investigated for MJNTNNs with time-varying delay in this paper. By employing a new LKF, reciprocally convex combination technique and integral inequality approach, the delay-dependent stability condition for the proposed MJNTNNs is established in the form of LMIs, which can be easily computed by making use of the effective Matlab LMI toolbox. An example with simulations is provided to show the utility and advantages of the proposed results.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Adjustment Model of Monitoring Frequency based on Cloud Security
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: As the core technology of cloud computing, virtualization technology supports the entire cloud computing virtualization service, whose security is critical to cloud computing. And the virtual machine is carrying a large number of services, becoming a very attractive target for attack, and suffering more and more attackers' attack. As a result, virtual machine security is an important aspect of virtualization security. This paper proposes a monitoring frequency dynamic adjustment model based on cloud security, aiming to improve the security of virtual machine and ensure the security of cloud platform. The validity of the model is validated by the simulation experiment.

articleTitle: Researches on the Calculation Method of Saturation Flow Rate at Signalized Intersection Based on K-means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: This paper studies K-means clustering algorithm for the calculation of saturation flow rate at signalized intersection. The calculation results are based on the measured traffic data, which are surveyed at the intersection of Xinhua Road and Youyi Road in Tangshan. By analyzing the distribution characteristics of average headway in a day, this paper presents the negative influences of unsaturated or oversaturated traffic flow on headway. A portion of the average headway affected by unsaturated or oversaturated condition are removed by K-means clustering algorithm. The developed method is used to calculate the saturation flow rate within different conditions. The calculation results illustrate that the proposed method can offset the effects of unsaturated or oversaturated condition.

articleTitle: A Novel Feature Weighted Strategy on Data Classification
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Most feature weighted algorithms does not take into account the correlation between features, so the redundancy with interference have a negative impact on the final classification results. In order to solve this problem, a feature weighting strategy is proposed, which considering correlation between features based on mutual information. The strategy introduces the correlation coefficient of inter feature as an index to measure the redundancy, and calculates the penalty factor of each feature to deal with the corresponding weight gained by mutual information, which reflects the real contribution of the feature to the classification as much as possible. Compared with several different algorithms on several datasets, the new strategy has better robustness and generalization ability.

articleTitle: Analysis of Space Crowdsourcing Mission Completion Based on Logistic Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: An important impetus to rapid development of crowdsourcing platform is the analysis on driving force of its task completion. It guides enterprises to carry out strategic adjustment. This paper used geographic data visualization software to qualitatively analyze the impact of driving factors on task completion, utilized Logistic Regression Model to deeply analyze the causes of task failure from a geographic perspective. Results showed that the task completion is composed of customer and task, which are greatly affected by the regional task pricing and the number of regional customers. Therefore, the companies should improve the enthusiasm of customers and explore the task pricing strategies of different regions based on regional consideration of pricing.

articleTitle: Medium Access Control Based on Two Dimentional Random Backoff of Power Level and Sensing Time for Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: This paper analyzes the limitation of IEEE 802.11 protocol using a single power for node communication. On the basis of IEEE 802.11protocol and the basic power backoff protocol which introduces the idea of power backoff, a CSMATPB protocol with time and space backoff is proposed. The protocol increases the time competition window, while making the power backoff reduce the interference between nodes. Then, the three dimensional Markov chain model is established for this protocol. Through the results of numerical calculation and simulation analysis, it is proved that the protocol mechanism can effectively solve the problem that the lower space reuse rate of IEEE 802.11 protocol and the problem that the basic power backoff protocol discards the packet prematurely. So CSMATPB protocol can effectively improve the saturation throughput and energy utilization of the network.

articleTitle: Multi-layer Chaotic Data Analysis: A Scalable Way in Processing Chaotic Data Based on Feature Engineering and Gradient Descent
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Chaotic dataset is one of the most common form of dataset, may getting in case of prediction events in the real world. And an important factor to consider is the countless parameters related to a chaotic dataset. This paper develops multi-layer chaotic data analysis, a method to set several layers in order to decrease the amount of parameters in regression algorithms used over chaotic dataset, and make comparisons with traditional method which fits "normal" dataset well. The theory shows a new way to combine human experience with machine learning algorithms, and comparison results show a huge boost of accuracy in practical situation.

articleTitle: Motion Identification by Magnetic Anomaly Detection Employing a Fluxgate Crisscross Network : -2D Parameters Identification for Uniform Linear Motion
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Magnetic anomaly detection (MAD) is a reliable tool for ferromagnetic objects detecting, even the hidden moving targets. In this paper, a novel method of two-dimension motion parameters identification by magnetic anomaly detection using a fluxgate crisscross network is proposed and implemented. The primarily achieved system consists of 13 single-axis fluxgates arranged as a crisscross network, and the magnetic parameters of each sensor are <; 5pT/√HZ@1HZ noise level, 0.5nT/hour stability and 1Hz bandwidth, and all sensors have self-balance and geomagnetic field compensation function. The primary results confirm the effectiveness of the magnetic anomaly detection system for motion parameters identification, especially the crisscross network structure and 2D parameter identification algorithm. For more precise identification, the replacement of fluxgate with much-higher-performance magnetometers such as SQUID and AM and increment of the sensors utilized can be helpful. This MAD system also has the potential to expand to 3D detection by structure and algorithm updating.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Fast and Elitist Non-dominated Sorting Generic Algorithm in Coal Blending optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: In view of coal blending optimization in thermal power plants, a multi-objective coal blending optimization model is proposed. The model uses coal quality indexes as constraint condition to construct three objective functions of economy, environmental protection and safety. The fast and elitist non-dominated sorting generic algorithm is used as the algorithm of solving the model. Combined with actual coal blending problem in domestic thermal power plants, the Pareto solution set is obtained. Results of example show that the algorithm has a good optimization effect and provides effective technical support for actual coal blending technology.

Author Keywords: fast and elitist non-dominated sorting generic algorithm

articleTitle: Application of Improved Multi-scale Normalization
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: In this paper, a method based on neighborhood information is proposed, which adjusts the parameters by using a method of chi square with Gauss weighted distance and the selfadaptability of shared neighbor weighting. And by integrating the nearest neighbor weighted adaptive method, each pixel is automatically given a scale parameter to reduce the need to adjust the parameters. Gauss weighted local neighborhood information is introduced in this paper, to construct the similarity matrix directly on the original image. At the same time, based on the existing graph-cut image segmentation method is necessary to construct a better network graph by using the maximum flow minimum cut. So, NJW algorithm is replaced by a improved Graph cut which combines the multi-scale analysis method, to improve the efficiency of the original segmentation method and enhance the clinical usability.

articleTitle: Simulation and Performance Analysis of Tactical Battlefield Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Battlefield communication network is the key factor to decide the outcome of war. With digital forces as the research background, the tactical battlefield communication network as the research object, based on discrete event driven mechanism, this paper builds up a simulation scenario of battlefield communication network using the hierarchical modeling mechanism, battlefield communication network simulation of the cable network, military radio network, satellite network and other means of communication components, studies the effect of different constraint conditions in battlefield communication by applying interference simulation data by modifying the device parameters and node. Experimental results show that the discrete event driven mechanism and layered modeling mechanism are effective methods to achieve network simulation, with high efficiency and reliable results. It can provide a good supporting role for the construction of battlefield communication network.

articleTitle: Research on Motion Prediction Algorithm Based on Nash Equilibrium
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: The Nash equilibrium method is studied in this paper, and a new motion prediction algorithm based on Nash equilibrium is proposed. This method includes 3 main contents: 1. Analyze and abstract the influencing factors of object motion. 2. Analyze the effects of each factor and list the Nash equilibrium equation. 3. Find the optimal solution of the system of equations. Nash equilibrium method is used to attain the purpose of overall consideration of all influencing factors of motion prediction. This algorithm can solve the problem that the current motion prediction algorithm can't take all the influence factors into account. To verify this method, this method is introduced to the ocean drift motion prediction and prove the accuracy of the method through three sets of comparison experiments.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Evaluation Method on Operation Quality of Power Backbone Optical Communication Network Based on Improved TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: To efficiently meet the requirements of running quality evaluation and maintenance of Power Electric Communication Network, based on the improved method of TOPSIS, this paper provides the method of comprehensive evaluation on running quality of Power Electric Communication Network. Firstly, this paper analyses the main reasons infecting running quality of Power Electric Communication Network and constructs corresponding indexes system. Then, the traditional method and characters of TOPSIS are instructed, improved by importing the method of RSR. Finally, taking Sichuan backbone optical communication network as the case to implement the proposed evaluation method, the results provide the running information of all sub-networks, displaying that absolutely value and balanced degree both influence the running situation of communication network, what's more, with different grades, relevant departments can fulfill differentiation management and scientific strategy.

articleTitle: Collaborative Filtering with Graph-based Implicit Feedback
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: Introducing consumed items as users' implicit feedback in matrix factorization (MF) method, SVD++is one of the most effective collaborative filtering methods for personalized recommender systems. However, powerful SVD++ has two limitations: (i) only the user-side implicit feedback is utilized instead of item-side implicit feedback which can also enrich item representations; (ii) in SVD++, the interacted items are equally weighted when combining the implicit feedback, which cannot reflect user's true preferences accurately. To tackle the above limitations, this paper proposes Graph-based collaborative filtering (GCF) model, Weighted Graph-based collaborative filtering (W-GCF) model and Attentive Graph-based collaborative filtering (A-GCF) model, which (i). generalize the implicit feedback to item side based on the user-item bipartite graph; (ii). flexibly learn the weights of individuals in the implicit feedback to improve the model's capacity. Comprehensive experiments show that the proposed models outperform state-of-the-art models. For sparse implicit feedback scenarios, additional improvement is further achieved by leveraging the two-step implicit feedback information.

articleTitle: Time Delay Estimation Based on Backtracking Gradient Descent
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Internet of Things (CCIOT)
abstract: In delay estimation of wireless positioning under less samples (single snapshot) and low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) condition, the use of sparse reconstruction method can improve the estimation accuracy. However, the existing reconstruction algorithms have wrong and missed election in the choice of atoms, resulting in the limitation of final estimation accuracy. In view of this problem, this paper considers the Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) communication system and proposes a novel delay estimation algorithm based on Backtracking Gradient Descent (BGD). Firstly, the algorithm establishes a sparse representation model of channel impulse response. Secondly, it proves that the sensing matrix satisfies the Restricted Isometry Property (RIP). Thirdly, the minimization of the inequality constraint l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> norm is rewritten as the l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> norm and the Gradient Descent (GD) algorithm is derived. Then, the backtracking mechanism is introduced and the BGD algorithm is proposed. Finally, it obtains the unbiased delay estimation with the one by one correspondence between the delay value and the complex fading coefficient of sparse coefficient vector. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has much higher estimation accuracy than the Root-Music algorithm. At the same time, compared with the GD algorithm, the performance is greatly improved at the expense of little complexity increase.
